story.text: …뭐 하는 거예요, 지금. 자리에 똑바로 앉아요.
story.reading: …mwo ha-neun geo-ye-yo, ji-geum. ja-ri-e ttok-ba-ro anj-a-yo.
story.en: ...What are you doing right now. Sit properly in your seat.

story.text: 됐고, '안전벨트'나 매요. 저는 이런 거 대충 넘기는 거 딱 질색이에요.
story.reading: dwaet-go, 'an-jeon-bel-teu'na mae-yo. jeo-neun i-reon geo dae-chung neom-gi-neun geo ttak jil-saeg-i-e-yo.
story.en: Never mind, just fasten your 'seatbelt'. I absolutely hate cutting corners on stuff like this.

story.text: 비행 전에 '점검'만 몇 번을 하는지 알아요? 하나라도 대충 넘기면 안 되니까.
story.reading: bi-haeng jeon-e 'jeom-geom'man myeot beon-eul ha-neun-ji al-a-yo? ha-na-ra-do dae-chung neom-gi-myeon an doe-ni-kka.
story.en: Do you know how many times I do a 'check' before every flight? Can't let even one thing slide.

story.text: 다 저만의 '순서'가 있어요. 그거 하나라도 어긋나면 마음이 안 놓여요.
story.reading: da jeo-man-ui 'sun-seo'ga iss-eo-yo. geu-geo ha-na-ra-do eo-geun-na-myeon ma-eum-i an noh-yeo-yo.
story.en: I have my own 'routine' for everything. If even one step is off, I can't relax.

story.text: 즉흥적인 거 딱 질색이에요. '규칙'대로, 순서대로. 그래야 안 다쳐요.
story.reading: jeuk-heung-jeog-in geo ttak jil-saeg-i-e-yo. 'gyu-chik'dae-ro, sun-seo-dae-ro. geu-rae-ya an da-chyeo-yo.
story.en: I can't stand anything impulsive. Follow the 'rules', follow the steps. That's how nobody gets hurt.

story.text: '걱정' 마요. 이 노선 몇 년째 몰아요. 준비된 사람이니까, 나만 믿어요.
story.reading: 'geok-jeong' ma-yo. i no-seon myeot nyeon-jjae mol-a-yo. jun-bi-doen sa-ram-i-ni-kka, na-man mid-eo-yo.
story.en: Don't 'worry'. I've flown this route for years. I'm someone who's always prepared, so just trust me.

story.text: …왜 자꾸 쳐다봐요. 착륙할 때까지 얌전히 있어요.
story.reading: …wae ja-kku chyeo-da-bwa-yo. chang-nyug-hal ttae-kka-ji yam-jeon-hi iss-eo-yo.
story.en: ...Why do you keep staring. Just sit tight until we land.

words.example_en: Please be sure to fasten your seatbelt.
I do a thorough check before takeoff.
It's easier when I prepare step by step.

sentences.en: We depart after finishing the check.
I check things one by one, in order.
Following the rules keeps you safe.
